visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short black hair tied in two low pigtails and a small white hairclip stands against a plain white wall. She wears a bright yellow short-sleeved T-shirt under a sleeveless orange dress with a scalloped neckline and two yellow circle patterns, resembling the doll from the series Squid Game. She stands on a light wood-colored floor, looking slightly off-camera with a neutral, calm expression. (2) The girl suddenly begins dancing energetically. She moves her arms in sharp, rhythmic punching and swinging motions and kicks her legs outward while maintaining a serious and highly concentrated facial expression. The camera remains static in a medium full shot, capturing her full-body movements against the plain white background. Her movements are quick, powerful, and synchronized with an unseen beat. (3) She continues her performance with stylized movements, incorporating a 'V' sign with her fingers and various hand gestures. She performs a low, wide-legged squatting motion with her hands on her knees before popping back up to continue a high-energy series of punches and arm sweeps. The intensity of her focus and her rapid footwork remain consistent throughout the high-energy performance until the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, child-like vocal sample repeats a rhythmic Korean phrase corresponding to the 'Red Light, Green Light' chant. The voice is dry and clear with a slight studio reverb, standing alone against absolute silence. No musical accompaniment is present during this brief introductory phase, creating a sharp focus on the rhythmic vocal delivery. (2) Immediately after the chant, a high-tempo EDM track enters with a hard-hitting kick drum and buzzy synthesizer melodies. The transition is a sudden hard cut, shifting the audio environment into a dense, high-energy musical floor. The percussive beat is driving and consistent, with no additional vocals heard during this energetic instrumental surge. (3) The EDM track continues at a fast BPM with layered synth textures. A deep, processed male voice enters the mix, rhythmically shouting 'Be aggressive' as a vocal loop integrated into the music production. The spectral brightness remains high as the bass and percussion maintain a dominant, club-like intensity until the audio track abruptly finishes.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an entertaining performance of a viral dance trend. By combining the iconic costume and vocal sample from 'Squid Game' with a modern EDM remix, the video leverages recognizable pop-culture elements to showcase the child's energetic and precise dance routine.
